title: Link Extractor from a Webpage
description: Scrape all absolute links from a given URL using BeautifulSoup and print them.
problemStatement: Write a script `link_extractor.py` that defines a function `extract_links(url)`. It fetches the page, parses it with BeautifulSoup, and prints all absolute URLs found in `<a href="...">` tags. Use `urllib.parse.urljoin` to resolve relative links. Print each link on a new line. Call it with `'https://example.com'` (a safe target). Handle request errors.
hints: If 'href' in a.attrs, resolve with `urljoin(url, a['href'])`.
Filter out empty or `#` links if desired.
expectedOutput: A list of absolute URLs like 'https://www.iana.org/domains/example' etc.
solutionCode:
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urljoin

def extract_links(url):
    try:
        resp = requests.get(url, timeout=5)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'html.parser')
        for a in soup.find_all('a', href=True):
            href = a['href']
            full = urljoin(url, href)
            print(full)
    except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")

extract_links('https://example.com')
